representation_fit.evidence: Both screenshots (1280x860, 1440x900) show a 960x600 room canvas (styles.css:71) with zone semantics (窗边采光带/动线通道/储物区/休闲区, data.js:22-27) and 10 placed canvas objects; create verb is primary via 8-type palette + stamp/drag placement (data.js:9-18, app.js:236-277) — matches create × spatial-workspace / canvas_object / physical shape exactly.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Canvas dominates the initial screen in both viewports; create/placement is surfaced in three permanent places: palette with numbered keys and tip '按 1-8 选类型，N 快速放置' (index.html:25), inspector tip '落位即意图：把物品放进对应区域…' (index.html:44), and status bar mode hints (app.js:217-222).

time_to_understand.evidence: Header states the job in one line '空间排布画板 · 落位即意图' (index.html:12); zone labels carry hints ('宜放书桌 · 绿植', '保持通畅 · 勿放物品', data.js:23-24); initial state is a worked example with 0 conflicts ('冲突物品 0 件' in both screenshots); status bar shows first-action hint '按 Tab 选择，方向键移动' (app.js:564).

navigation_cost.evidence: Single screen, zero navigation: palette, canvas, inspector, undo/redo all visible at load (screenshots both viewports); creating an object is 2 keystrokes (1-8 then N, app.js:263-277, 503-508) or click+click/drag (app.js:421-452); no routes, modes, or dialogs between intent and object.

context_loss.evidence: Primary actions never leave the workspace: stamp mode persists for continuous placement until Esc (app.js:223-233, 447-449); placement/move/rotate feedback is inline in the status bar via narrateWhere (app.js:210-214) rather than modal dialogs; Tab cycling and inspector edits happen in place (app.js:283-292, 525-539).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Five permanent surfaces, all job-relevant: topbar (3 buttons + 2 chips, index.html:11-19), palette (8 types, index.html:22-26), canvas, inspector (summary + per-object editor toggled by selection, index.html:36-68), status bar (index.html:71-74); help overlay is on-demand and hidden (index.html:76, app.js:460-463). No dead controls observed in source or screenshots.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt: a11y.target_size pass, a11y.contrast fail, a11y.focus_order skipped, type.min_projected_size fail (measurement-summary.json checks). Keyboard equivalence is genuinely strong (arrows/Shift-step, R, [/], Tab, Del, Enter/F2, Ctrl+Z/Y — app.js:465-510; documented help table index.html:83-107) and inputs have focus styles (styles.css:137). But contrast and minimum type size checks fail, consistent with source: 10px low-contrast text at styles.css:66 (pal-size #94a3b8 10px), styles.css:91 (zone-hint 10px, opacity .8), styles.css:114 (obj-label 10px), styles.css:159 (insp-tip #94a3b8). Focus order unverifiable (skipped).

frontend_rework.evidence: Visible defect at 1280x860: the 960x600 room plus border exceeds the stage width (1280−176−240 padding box) so the right edge of the room/window zone is clipped at load, only recoverable by scroll — matches layout.overflow=fail and contrasts with the fully visible room at 1440x900 (styles.css:69-71 fixed 960px width, overflow:auto). Receipt also fails a11y.contrast and type.min_projected_size (implying style rework); layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation, a11y.target_size pass, so core layout is otherwise sound. Minor: initial 龟背竹 label overlaps the zone hint text in both viewports (screenshots).

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Acceptance seed '空间操作有键盘等价物' is covered exhaustively and verifiably: create (1-8+N, index.html:85-87), move (arrows 10px/Shift 1px, app.js:486-492), precise coordinates via X/Y inputs (app.js:525-539), rotate R/Shift+R with footprint swap (app.js:302-316, 494-495), z-order [/] (app.js:337-348), Tab/Shift+Tab selection (app.js:488), D/dup, Del delete, Enter/F2 rename, Ctrl+Z/Y undo/redo; all enumerated in the help overlay (index.html:83-107) with the tag '所有空间操作均有键盘等价物' (index.html:80). The 落位即意图 success criterion is also operationalized (zoneOf/suggestFor/warningsOf, app.js:43-60).

defects_observed: layout.overflow (check id): at 1280x860 the fixed 960x600 room (styles.css:71) is clipped on the right at initial load; visible in screenshots/1280x860.png, fits at 1440x900
a11y.contrast fail (check id): low-contrast 10-11px gray text (#94a3b8 / opacity .8) at styles.css:66-67, 91, 159
type.min_projected_size fail (check id): 10px text at styles.css:66 (pal-size), styles.css:91 (zone-hint), styles.css:114 (obj-label)
Minor visual collision: initial plant label 龟背竹 overlaps zone hint text in both viewports (screenshots)
missing_evidence: a11y.focus_order was skipped in the receipt (measurement-summary.json) — focus order could not be verified
scores.overall_note: This is a tightly on-brief spatial-workspace implementation: a single-screen room canvas where placement into semantic zones IS the intent (zones with keep-clear aisle, per-zone tallies, suggestions and conflict warnings in source app.js:43-60), the create verb is the dominant first-screen activity via a numbered palette with stamp/drag/keyboard placement, and the acceptance seed — every spatial operation having a keyboard equivalent — is implemented and documented exhaustively (app.js:465-510, index.html:83-107). Initial state is ready at load with zero conflicts, matching the brief's no-loading-state constraint. The deductions come from measurable surface defects: at 1280x860 the fixed-size room overflows its stage and is clipped at load (layout.overflow fail), and the receipt fails contrast and minimum projected type size, consistent with several 10px low-contrast labels in styles.css; focus order could not be assessed because that check was skipped. No missing functionality, truncation, responsive collision, or interaction defects were observed; per the rubric, task time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not judged here, and no human-preference claim is implied by these scores.
